name: Quintia Road
source:
You play as Michael Ilgner, a German WWII pilot who gets his plane sucked into a strange vortex. He finds himself in the world of Quintia, a fantasy land filled with monsters, beautiful women, and a huge war. Being a soldier, Michael takes it upon himself to fight Quintia's war and free the people from their monstrous oppressors. He never wanted to fight in WWII anyway, so he's more than happy to fight for Quintia.

Michael travels all over Quintia in his Me 109, The Love Machine. He meets all kinds of people, frees villages from tyrannical monsters, an is hailed as the savior of the land by those who believe in him. He even attracts the attention of two beautiful women who both aid him along the way. Sure beats getting shot at by allied planes, right?
translation:
玩家扮演第二次世界大战期间的德国飞行员米夏埃尔·伊尔格纳。他驾驶的战机被一股诡异旋涡吸入，醒来后发现自己来到昆蒂亚：一片遍布魔物、美女并陷入大战的奇幻大陆。身为军人，米夏埃尔决定投身昆蒂亚的战争，从魔物暴君手中解放当地百姓。反正他本就不想参加第二次世界大战，能为昆蒂亚而战，他反倒乐意之至。

米夏埃尔驾驶名为“爱之机器号”的梅塞施密特Bf 109战斗机，飞遍昆蒂亚各地。他结识形形色色的人，从暴虐魔物手中解放村庄，还被信任他的民众奉为救世主。就连两名美女也注意到了他，并在旅途中相继伸出援手。这可比遭盟军战机追着炮击强多了，对吧？
